annotation.title_clean: 国土交通省関係国家戦略特別区域法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the National Strategic Special Zones Act (MLIT-related)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MLIT ministerial ordinance implementing the National Strategic Special Zones Act's provisions on paid private-vehicle passenger transport for tourists. It sets eligible operators, application and registration requirements, and includes provisions covering automated-operation passenger transport and specified automated operation under the Road Traffic Act. Amended 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Lists eligible entities for special-zone paid private tourist passenger transport (municipalities, NPOs, cooperatives, etc.).
Application must include operation management, maintenance, accident response and damage compensation documents.
Operators of automated-operation passenger transport must submit automated driving device use conditions.
Specified automated operation requires documents showing likelihood of Road Traffic Act permit.
Applies Road Transport Act enforcement rules with substitutions for special-zone transport.
